title: Tanks get a number view and a reward
author: Shockwave, Engine Lead, with Blitzwing
body: Each tank's view of a match can now be written as 176 numbers, and an action read back from four, without using new memory. A per-tick reward pays for hits and gives ±1 for a win or loss. Positions scale with the match's own map. Every pinned hash, parity fixture and replay file is unchanged, and Blitzwing's 24 tests pass.
next: Blitzwing's test PR, then the Python package.
